cases.email: I was charged $49.99 twice this month for my Pro subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge, invoice INV-1123.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was double-charged for their subscription and wants the duplicate refunded.
cases.notes: Unambiguous double-charge refund request with an invoice number. Baseline easy billing case.

cases.email: My credit card on file expired and I can't update my payment method, the form just spins forever.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot update their expired payment method because the form doesn't submit.
cases.notes: Mentions a broken form (technical symptom) but the underlying request is a payment-method update, so billing is the right call over technical.

cases.email: Can you send me an itemized invoice for last quarter? I need it for our expense report.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests an itemized invoice for last quarter for expense reporting.
cases.notes: Clean invoice request, no edge-case elements.

cases.email: I was billed for the annual plan but I only signed up for monthly, and now I also can't log in to check my settings.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was billed for the wrong plan and is also locked out of their account.
cases.notes: Two distinct issues (wrong billing plan + login lockout). Billing is the primary complaint the customer leads with; a real triage system has to pick one category.

cases.email: I want to downgrade from the Team plan to the Starter plan starting next billing cycle.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to downgrade their plan starting next billing cycle.
cases.notes: Plain plan-change request.

cases.email: I just got a chargeback notice from my bank for a payment I actually authorized. Can you help me sort this out?
cases.expected_summary: Customer received a chargeback notice for a payment they say was authorized and wants it resolved.
cases.notes: Chargeback/dispute vocabulary is less common than 'refund' or 'charged' but is still clearly billing.

cases.email: I want to cancel my subscription, it's just too expensive for what I'm using it for.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to cancel their subscription due to cost.
cases.notes: Straightforward cancellation-for-price request.

cases.email: If I upgrade to the Pro plan in the middle of my billing cycle, will I be charged the full price or a prorated amount?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether a mid-cycle upgrade will be charged in full or prorated.
cases.notes: A pricing/policy question rather than a problem report - tests that the classifier doesn't require something to be 'broken' to call it billing.

cases.email: i think i was over charge for teh anual plan can u chek my last invoic pls
cases.expected_summary: Customer believes they were overcharged for the annual plan and wants their invoice checked.
cases.notes: Heavy typos ('teh', 'anual', 'chek', 'invoic') - tests robustness to misspellings on an otherwise clear billing request.

cases.email: Refund??
cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking about a refund with no further detail.
cases.notes: Extremely short, no context at all. Only signal is the single word 'Refund' - realistic worst-case input.

cases.email: Oh great, charged AGAIN for a plan I already cancelled last month. Love it. Really great system you've got here.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged again for a plan they say they already cancelled.
cases.notes: Sarcastic tone ('Love it', 'Really great system') - the real complaint (unwanted charge after cancellation) needs to be extracted past the sarcasm.

cases.email: Hola, me cobraron dos veces (charged twice) este mes, please help con el refund, gracias.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged twice this month and is asking for a refund.
cases.notes: Mixed Spanish/English (code-switching). The English words ('charged twice', 'refund') carry the signal but a brittle keyword match tuned to English phrasing could miss the Spanish framing.

cases.email: Could you email me a receipt for my last payment? I need it for tax filing purposes.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a receipt for their last payment for tax purposes.
cases.notes: Simple receipt request.

cases.email: I'm being charged an extra 3% on every payment that I think is a currency conversion fee, is that expected?
cases.expected_summary: Customer questions an unexpected currency conversion fee on their payments.
cases.notes: Less common billing vocabulary (currency conversion fee) than 'refund' or 'invoice'.

cases.email: Can I switch my payment method from credit card to PayPal for future charges?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to switch their payment method to PayPal.
cases.notes: Plain payment-method-change request.

cases.email: The export button on the reports page throws a 500 error every time I click it.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the reports page export button throws a 500 error.
cases.notes: Unambiguous bug report with an explicit error code.

cases.email: Our integration stopped receiving webhook events from your API around 2am UTC last night.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's integration stopped receiving webhook events from the API overnight.
cases.notes: Developer-facing integration language rather than consumer bug language.

cases.email: The mobile app crashes immediately on launch since the latest update on my Android phone.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's mobile app crashes on launch after the latest update on Android.
cases.notes: Clear crash report tied to a specific update and platform.

cases.email: We're suddenly hitting rate limit errors on the /v1/orders endpoint even though our request volume hasn't changed.
cases.expected_summary: Customer is unexpectedly hitting rate limit errors on the orders API endpoint.
cases.notes: API/rate-limit specific technical issue.

cases.email: The charts on my dashboard just show a spinner forever and never load any data.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's dashboard charts never finish loading and just spin.
cases.notes: Common 'stuck loading' bug report.

cases.email: Every CSV I export has garbled characters instead of accented letters, the encoding seems wrong.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's CSV exports have garbled characters due to an apparent encoding issue.
cases.notes: Specific, less common bug type (character encoding) that still clearly belongs in technical.

cases.email: Dark mode turns off every time I refresh the page, it doesn't seem to save my preference.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's dark mode preference doesn't persist across page refreshes.
cases.notes: Minor cosmetic bug, still unambiguously technical.

cases.email: It's broken.
cases.expected_summary: Customer says something is broken with no further detail.
cases.notes: Extremely short and vague - no product area named at all. Tests graceful handling of near-zero-information input.

cases.email: teh api keeps timeing out wen i try to uplaod files bigger then 10mb
cases.expected_summary: Customer's API requests time out when uploading files larger than 10MB.
cases.notes: Heavy typos on an otherwise clear technical/API report.

cases.email: Since the last update I can't access any of my saved reports anymore, they just don't show up.
cases.expected_summary: Customer can no longer access their saved reports after the latest update.
cases.notes: Could read as an account/access issue, but 'since the last update' points to a software regression rather than an account permissions problem.

cases.email: Cool, your '99.9% uptime' API has been down for 3 hours straight this morning. Impressive.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports the API has been down for three hours despite the advertised uptime.
cases.notes: Sarcastic framing ('Impressive', quoting the uptime claim) around a clear outage report.

cases.email: Bonjour, l'application crash (it crashes) every time I open the settings page, please fix.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's application crashes every time they open the settings page.
cases.notes: Mixed French/English. 'crash' is a cognate in both languages, but the surrounding sentence structure is French.

cases.email: A browser extension I have installed seems to break your UI, buttons overlap and menus don't open.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's browser extension appears to be breaking the product's UI layout.
cases.notes: Third-party-caused bug, still a technical/UI report.

cases.email: After rotating our API key, webhook signature verification started failing on every incoming event.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's webhook signature verification fails on every event after rotating their API key.
cases.notes: Dense developer/security terminology (signature verification, key rotation) - realistic for a technical support queue but harder to parse than a plain bug report.

cases.email: Every page on the site has been loading really slowly for the past two days.
cases.expected_summary: Customer reports slow page load times across the entire site for two days.
cases.notes: Straightforward performance complaint.

cases.email: I can't log in, it says my password is incorrect but I just reset it five minutes ago.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in despite recently resetting their password.
cases.notes: Classic login/password issue.

cases.email: How do I enable two-factor authentication on my account? I don't see the option in settings.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to enable two-factor authentication but can't find the setting.
cases.notes: Plain account-settings question.

cases.email: I need to change the email address associated with my account since I no longer have access to the old one.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to change their account email address.
cases.notes: Standard account-detail change request.

cases.email: Getting a 'session expired' error every few minutes even though I just logged in.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's session keeps expiring shortly after logging in.
cases.notes: Could be read as a technical/session bug, but it directly affects login/access so account is the better fit; borderline with technical.

cases.email: I got locked out after too many failed login attempts, how do I get back in?
cases.expected_summary: Customer is locked out after too many failed login attempts and wants to regain access.
cases.notes: Plain lockout request.

cases.email: I accidentally created two accounts with different emails, can you merge them into one?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants their two duplicate accounts merged into one.
cases.notes: Less common account-management request (merging accounts).

cases.email: I'm trying to verify my identity to finish signup but the verification email never arrives, even after resending.
cases.expected_summary: Customer's identity verification email never arrives, blocking signup.
cases.notes: Email-delivery symptom could look technical, but the underlying request is about completing account verification/signup.

cases.email: Locked out.
cases.expected_summary: Customer says they are locked out with no further detail.
cases.notes: Extremely short with almost no context, similar in spirit to gd-023 but for account access.

cases.email: cant reset my paswrod the link keeps expireing before i click it
cases.expected_summary: Customer's password reset link keeps expiring before they can use it.
cases.notes: Heavy typos ('paswrod', 'expireing') on an otherwise clear password-reset issue.

cases.email: I want to permanently delete my account and all my data, please confirm once it's done.
cases.expected_summary: Customer requests permanent deletion of their account and data.
cases.notes: Account deletion / data-erasure (GDPR-style) request - a distinct and consequential account-management flow.

cases.email: Wow, 'account security' locked ME out for logging in from a new phone. Fantastic system you've built.
cases.expected_summary: Customer was locked out of their account for logging in from a new device.
cases.notes: Sarcastic tone around a clear account-lockout issue caused by a security check.

cases.email: Hallo, ich kann mich nicht einloggen (I can't log in), meine Email wird nicht erkannt, please help.
cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in because their email isn't being recognized.
cases.notes: Mixed German/English. Requires reading the German clause to get the full picture (email not recognized) rather than just the English aside.

cases.email: My profile picture upload keeps failing and reverting to the default image, is this a known issue?
cases.expected_summary: Customer's profile picture upload fails and reverts to the default image.
cases.notes: Could plausibly be filed as technical (an upload bug), but it's specifically about the account profile, so account is the intended label; documents a real category boundary.

cases.email: I'm leaving the company, can you transfer ownership of this account to my colleague's email instead?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to transfer account ownership to a colleague before leaving.
cases.notes: Multi-step, less common account-management request (ownership transfer).

cases.email: I got an alert about a login from an unfamiliar device in another country, was that really me or should I be worried?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to confirm whether a login alert from an unfamiliar device and location was legitimate.
cases.notes: Security-alert-driven account question, no explicit error message to key off of.

cases.email: Just wanted to say the new onboarding flow is way smoother than before, nice work!
cases.expected_summary: Customer compliments the improved onboarding flow.
cases.notes: Pure positive feedback, no request at all.

cases.email: Do you offer volume discounts for teams over 50 seats? We're evaluating a few vendors.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks about volume discounts for a team over 50 seats.
cases.notes: Pre-sales pricing question, distinct from a billing dispute about an existing charge.

cases.email: What's your roadmap for the next few months? Curious if SSO is planned.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks about the product roadmap and whether SSO is planned.
cases.notes: Forward-looking product question, not a support issue.

cases.email: Not sure who to ask, but is there a way to export all my data before I close my account?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks how to export their data before closing their account.
cases.notes: Overlaps with account (mentions closing the account), but the customer explicitly frames it as an open-ended 'not sure who to ask' question, so general is the intended label.

cases.email: Could you point me to your data privacy and retention policy? Our legal team is asking.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks for the company's data privacy and retention policy.
cases.notes: Policy/documentation request, not tied to a specific account problem.

cases.email: Is it possible to schedule a live demo of the enterprise features with someone on your team?
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to schedule a demo of the enterprise features.
cases.notes: Sales/demo request.

cases.email: Hi, I saw your job posting for a support engineer, is it still open? Attaching my resume.
cases.expected_summary: Sender asks about a job posting and attaches their resume.
cases.notes: Not a customer issue at all - a misdirected job application. Tests that the classifier doesn't force everything into the three support categories.

cases.email: Feature idea: it would be great if we could bulk-tag multiple records at once instead of one at a time.
cases.expected_summary: Customer suggests adding bulk-tagging for multiple records.
cases.notes: Feature request / product feedback.

cases.email: Hi
cases.expected_summary: Customer sent a greeting with no actual request or issue.
cases.notes: No actionable content whatsoever - the minimal-information floor case for the whole dataset.

cases.email: hey wat time zone is ur suport team in, tryin to figure out wen to call
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks what time zone the support team is in.
cases.notes: Heavy typos on a simple logistics question with no billing/technical/account content.

cases.email: Sure, 'contact us anytime' but nobody ever replies for days. Cool policy you've got.
cases.expected_summary: Customer complains sarcastically about slow response times from support.
cases.notes: Sarcastic complaint about support responsiveness itself rather than any product issue - doesn't map to billing/technical/account at all.

cases.email: Hola team, just curious cuando you'll add Spanish language support to the app?
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks when Spanish language support will be added to the app.
cases.notes: Mixed Spanish/English feature request, not tied to an existing account or bug.

cases.email: Do you have a referral program? I'd love to recommend this to other teams I work with.
cases.expected_summary: Customer asks whether there is a referral program.
cases.notes: Simple program/policy question.

cases.email: Please stop sending me marketing emails, I only want product/security notifications.
cases.expected_summary: Customer wants to stop receiving marketing emails but keep product/security ones.
cases.notes: Borders on account (a notification-preferences setting) but is framed as a general communication request rather than an account-access issue.

cases.email: LIMITED TIME OFFER: Grow your business 10x with our SEO service, reply now for a free consultation!!!
cases.expected_summary: Unsolicited promotional message with no genuine support request.
cases.notes: Spam-like promotional email that ended up in the support queue - not a real customer request; tests that the classifier doesn't force it into billing/technical/account.
